rows.23:98e0:
And would you believe it, the air around the stain was shimmering, like a rising mirage.
Now and then, the same expression as the face-shaped stain would surface in that mirage.
I watched the scene with bated breath.
Then, all of a sudden!
I felt something stroke the nape of my neck.
"Aah!"
I couldn't help crying out.{p}
rows.23:10350:
When I fearfully opened my eyes, in front of me was the lower half of a body in a skirt, hanging limply.
Following it upward with my eyes, I saw that the upper half had smashed through the glass of the door and was sticking out the other side.
Drip... drip... Warm blood fell onto my face.
Even when I peered at her, Ms. Hida didn't move. Her eyes had rolled back, and her face was full of resentment.
Apparently she'd cut her carotid artery on a shard of glass.{p}
rows.24:c258:
It was a murky, pitch-black color.
It had a grassy smell, like bitter medicinal herbs.
"It has an unusual taste, so people may either love it or hate it, but once you get used to it, it's irresistible.
Go on, try it."
...What would you do in a moment like this?{p}
